test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select No error'.

Ben Essenburg is widely known/ as one of the world's best portrayer / of the Everglades.

options.text: as one of the world's best portrayer

solution:
The correct answer is "**as one of the world's best portrayer**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the usage of the singular form of the noun "portrayer."
 
• The word "Portrayer" is a noun referring to someone who portrays something.
 
• We use a plural noun after “one of the” because we are talking about a group.
 
 
• In case of the given sentence, we are talking about the best portrayer among a group of portrayers.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• Ben Essenburg is widely known as one of the world's best portrayers__ of the Everglades.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
